sentences.text: Julianne Alexandra Hough -LRB- -LSB- hʌf -RSB- born July 20 , 1988 -RRB- is an American dancer , singer , and actress .	dancer	dancing	singer	singer	actress	actress
She is a two-time professional champion of ABC 's Dancing with the Stars .	Dancing with the Stars	Dancing with the Stars (U.S. TV series)	ABC	American Broadcasting Company

She was nominated for a Creative Arts Primetime Emmy in 2007 for Outstanding Choreography in season five of the show .	Creative Arts Primetime Emmy	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Choreography	season five	Dancing with the Stars (U.S. season 5)
Her first leading acting role was in the 2011 film remake of Footloose .	Footloose	Footloose (2011 film)
In September 2014 , Hough joined Dancing with the Stars as a permanent fourth judge .	Dancing with the Stars	Dancing with the Stars (U.S. TV series)

Along with her brother Derek Hough -LRB- who is a six-time winner of the dancing show -RRB- and Tessandra Chavez , she won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Choreography in 2015 .
